Copilot CLI beginner lesson from Tech Thursday: Cam described how guided building helped him get started.
Use a practice repo, make one small change, inspect the diff and run the check before expanding the task.
Follow @layer8culture if you're building with AI.

Claude Fable 5.2 in Copilot: check the data rule before the code.

GitHub added Fable 5.2 on Nov 9 for complex, multistep coding across large codebases. For builders, that's another candidate for a bounded maintenance task, not a reason to hand over the whole stack.

The part worth keeping beside your model picker: Fable 5.2 requires data retention by default for Anthropic's safety classifiers. GitHub says retained data isn't used to train Anthropic's models. Certain eligible enterprises can get zero-data-retention access under specific conditions; don't assume that applies to your account.

Try this week: use a public sample repo containing no personal data or secrets. Give the model one failing test and ask for the smallest fix. Read the diff, run the test and record usage cost before expanding.

Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise access is rolling out gradually. Business and Enterprise admins must enable the model policy, which is off by default. Check provider-list usage pricing too.

The bigger signal: choosing an AI coding model is becoming a workflow decision about data, permissions, checks and spend, not just capability.

Save this before your next model switch.
